**What is missing.** One concrete situation where the current commands are not enough.

**What you want the command to do.** Name an existing command if this extends one.

**What it must not do.** Costanza does not call a model, use the network, or accept an entry without a person at a terminal. A request that needs one of those is outside the tool.

**Spec.** If `docs/SPEC.md` or `ROADMAP.md` already says this is a non-goal, say why the non-goal should change. Do not re-open a rejected item without new evidence. Claude Code JSONL import and an automatic model runner for the benchmark are rejected.
